title: Smart Alone, Blind Together: Why Accuracy Fails to CertifyTheory of Mind in Multi-Agent Teams
abstract: arXiv:2610.19051v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Coordinators that act on what they infer about teammates are usually certified by the accuracy of those inferences. We argue that accuracy is the wrong certificate, for two reasons. First, the accuracy needed to act depends on what a wrong action costs, so the bar belongs to the deployment, not the module. Second, a module's errors are rarely independent, and dependence has a sign: positively associated errors help where their damage overlaps and hurt where it compounds, so an accuracy threshold fails in a predictable direction, and once wrong beliefs interact and can do harm, no rule based on accuracy is right for every module. We test these predictions in task assignment, Level-Based Foraging and Hanabi, with injected errors, trained and Bayesian modules and five language models, and in human judgments. translated_title: 独自聪明，集体失明：为什么准确性无法认证多智能体团队中的心智理论
translated_abstract: 基于对队友推断而采取行动的协调者，通常以这些推断的准确性作为认证标准。我们论证准确性是错误的认证依据，原因有二。首先，行动所需的准确性取决于错误行动的代价，因此这一标准应属于部署场景，而非模块本身。其次，模块的错误很少是独立的，且这种相关性有方向性：正相关的错误在其损害重叠时有益，而在损害叠加时有害，因此准确性阈值会以可预测的方向失效——一旦错误信念相互作用并可能造成伤害，就不存在对每个模块都正确的基于准确性的规则。我们在任务分配、Level-Based Foraging 和 Hanabi 中检验这些预测，使用了注入错误、训练的和贝叶斯模块、五个语言模型以及人类判断。准确性在两个方向上都失效了：在共享错误叠加的 Hanabi 中批准了有害的语言模型部署，同时拒绝了……（原文截断）
tldr: 该论文论证准确性不能作为认证多智能体团队中心智理论模块的标准，因为所需准确性取决于部署场景的错误代价，且模块间错误的相关性会使准确性阈值以可预测的方向失效。
en_tdlr: This paper argues that accuracy cannot certify Theory of Mind modules in multi-agent teams, since the required accuracy depends on deployment-specific error costs, and correlated errors cause accuracy thresholds to fail in predictable directions.
